summary: ICON plc filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its 2025 ICON Cares sustainability report, not a transactional event. The release touts ESG metrics: 97.05% renewable electricity, a 24% electricity reduction versus a 2018 baseline, and a 73.56% cut in Scope 1 and 2 emissions versus 2019, plus an EcoVadis Platinum score of 87/100 and a CDP improvement from B- to B. No securities, prices, stakes, advisors or board recommendations are disclosed; mechanics are limited to an exhibit and CFO signature. No deal or risk-arb angle applies.
